name: Digital India Internship Scheme
benefit:
1. A token stipend of ₹10,000/- per month would be paid to an intern, subject to satisfactory performance, duly certified by his supervisor/mentor.
   1. Certificates will be issued by the Ministry to the interns upon the completion of the internship and submission of the Report duly countersigned and accepted by the competent authority.

<br>

> **NOTE:**

    - The intern shall be paid
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be an Indian student. 
   1. The applicant should be pursuing studies at a recognized university in India.
   1. The applicant must have secured at least 60% marks in the last held degree or certificate examination and pursuing:

    - For the area mentioned at [Sl No. 1 to 21 of Table :](https://intern.meity.gov.in/public/assets/Files/DIIS-2025.pdf)

B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech (Computer Science &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; Engineering (CSE)/Computer Science (CS)/ IT/ Electronics &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; Communications (EC)/ Electronics/ Electrical).
M.Sc.(CS/IT/ Electronics/ Electrical)
MCA/DOEACC ‘B’ level

    - For the area mentioned at [Sl No. 22 of Table:](https://intern.meity.gov.in/public/assets/Files/DIIS-2025.pdf)

L.L.B.

    - For the area mentioned at [Sl. No. 23 of Table](https://intern.meity.gov.in/public/assets/Files/DIIS-2025.pdf)

Bachelor&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;s in Economics and Statistics

**Note:**
1. The students who are in the last semester or who will pass out in summer 2025 will not be eligible for the internship. Only students who are in the previous one year will be eligible.
2. Possessing minimum qualifications as above shall not guarantee internship in this Ministry. Candidates having exposure in the area of intended internship with good academic background and having higher qualification, based on need shall be given preference.
